<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 当前页码、每页条数与检索关键字
     */
    var page = 1;
    var size = 10;
    var keyword = "";

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染分页控件：共 N 条、第 X / Y 页，首页禁用上一页、末页禁用下一页
     */
    function renderPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {
        var total = totalCount || 0;
        page = currentPage || 1;
        size = pageSize || size;
        var pages = total === 0 ? 1 : Math.ceil(total / size);
        $("#pager_info").text("共 " + total + " 条");
        $("#pager_page").text("第 " + page + " / " + pages + " 页");
        $("#btn_prev_page").prop("disabled", page <= 1);
        $("#btn_next_page").prop("disabled", page >= pages);
    }

    /**
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 389 页
     * 渲染待审核活动列表
     */
    function renderActivityTable(activities) {
        var $body = $("#activity_table").empty();
        if (!activities || activities.length === 0) {
            $body.append('<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(activities, function (index, activity) {
            html += `<tr>
                        <td>${activity.activityName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${activity.activityLocation || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(activity.activityBegintime)}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(activity.activityEndtime)}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(activity.activitySignddl)}</td>
                        <td>${activity.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>
                        <td><a class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-primary btn-sm" href="act_not_audit.html">审核</a></td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 按当前分页与关键字查询待审核的志愿活动
     */
    function loadActivities() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/findAuditActivityByState",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": page,
                "size": size,
                "keyword": keyword
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "待审核活动加载失败");
                    return;
                }
                renderActivityTable(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("待审核活动加载失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 390 页
     * 加载工作台顶部统计：待审核活动数与待复核补录数
     */
    function loadCounters() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/findAuditActivityByState",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": 1,
                "size": 1
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result && result.extend) {
                    $("#count_audit").text(result.extend.total || 0);
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                $("#count_audit").text(0);
            }
        });
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/review/manualHours",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": 1,
                "size": 1,
                "state": "0"
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result && result.extend) {
                    $("#count_manual").text(result.extend.total || 0);
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                $("#count_manual").text(0);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 点击查询：关键字检索从第一页开始
     */
    $("#btn_search_activity").click(function () {
        keyword = $.trim($("#activity_keyword").val());
        page = 1;
        loadActivities();
    });

    /**
     * 点击重置：清空关键字并回到第一页
     */
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 391 页
    $("#btn_reset_activity").click(function () {
        $("#activity_keyword").val("");
        keyword = "";
        page = 1;
        loadActivities();
    });

    /**
     * 回车即查询
     */
    $("#activity_keyword").keydown(function (event) {
        if (event.keyCode === 13) {
            $("#btn_search_activity").click();
        }
    });

    /**
     * 分页按钮
     */
    $("#btn_prev_page").click(function () {
        if (page > 1) {
            page = page - 1;
            loadActivities();
        }
    });

    $("#btn_next_page").click(function () {
        page = page + 1;
        loadActivities();
    });

    /**
     * 进入页面即加载工作台统计与待审核活动列表
     */
    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadCounters();
        loadActivities();
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 当前页码、每页条数、检索关键字与复核状态筛选值
     */
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 401 页
    var page = 1;
    var size = 10;
    var keyword = "";
    var state = "";

    /**
     * 当前正在复核的签到编号
     */
    var currentCheckinNum = null;

    /**
     * 复核模态框实例
     */
    var reviewModal = null;

    /**
     * 异常待裁定区块独立的分页与检索状态
     */
    var anomalyPage = 1;
    var anomalySize = 10;
    var anomalyKeyword = "";

    /**
     * 当前正在裁定的异常记录编号与裁定结果（1 维持计入、2 冲销）
     */
    var anomalyTarget = {checkinNum: null, isPass: null};

    /**
     * 异常时长裁定模态框实例
     */
    var anomalyModal = null;

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 复核状态文案：空为待复核，1 已确认、2 已驳回
     */
    function reviewStateText(timecheck) {
        if (timecheck === "1") {
            return '<span class="badge badge-success">已确认</span>';
        }
        if (timecheck === "2") {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 402 页
            return '<span class="badge badge-danger">已驳回</span>';
        }
        return '<span class="badge badge-warning">待复核</span>';
    }

    /**
     * 渲染分页控件：共 N 条、第 X / Y 页，首页禁用上一页、末页禁用下一页
     */
    function renderPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {
        var total = totalCount || 0;
        page = currentPage || 1;
        size = pageSize || size;
        var pages = total === 0 ? 1 : Math.ceil(total / size);
        $("#pager_info").text("共 " + total + " 条");
        $("#pager_page").text("第 " + page + " / " + pages + " 页");
        $("#btn_prev_page").prop("disabled", page <= 1);
        $("#btn_next_page").prop("disabled", page >= pages);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染补录记录列表
     */
    function renderManualHours(checkins) {
        var $body = $("#manual_table").empty();
        if (!checkins || checkins.length === 0) {
            $body.append('<tr><td colspan="9" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(checkins, function (index, checkin) {
            var pending = !checkin.checkinTimecheck;
            var action = pending
                ? `<button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                           onclick="openReview(${checkin.checkinNum})">复核</button>`
                : '<span class="text-muted">已处理</span>';
            html += `<tr>
                        <td>${checkin.volunteerName || "—"}
                            <span class="d-block text-muted small">${checkin.volunteerId || ""} ${checkin.volunteerTel || ""}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td>${checkin.activityName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${checkin.organizationName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(checkin.checkinBegintime)}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(checkin.checkinEndtime)}</td>
                        <td>${checkin.checkinDuration || 0}</td>
                        <td>${checkin.checkinRemark || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${reviewStateText(checkin.checkinTimecheck)}</td>
                        <td>${action}</td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 403 页
    }

    /**
     * 按当前分页、状态与关键字查询补录记录
     */
    function loadManualHours() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/review/manualHours",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": page,
                "size": size,
                "state": state,
                "keyword": keyword
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "补录记录加载失败");
                    return;
                }
                renderManualHours(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("补录记录加载失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 打开复核弹窗并清空上一次的复核意见
     */
    function openReview(checkinNum) {
        currentCheckinNum = checkinNum;
        $("#review_information").text("正在复核补录记录：" + checkinNum);
        $("#review_remark").val("");
        if (!reviewModal) {
            reviewModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("reviewModal"));
        }
        reviewModal.show();
    }

    /**
     * 提交复核结果：isPass 为 1 确认时长、2 驳回
     */
    function submitReview(isPass) {
        if (currentCheckinNum === null) {
            alert("请先选择需要复核的补录记录");
            return;
        }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 404 页
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/review/manualHours/check",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "checkinNum": currentCheckinNum,
                "isPass": isPass,
                "remark": $.trim($("#review_remark").val())
            },
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "复核已完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    if (reviewModal) {
                        reviewModal.hide();
                    }
                    currentCheckinNum = null;
                    loadManualHours();
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("复核提交失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 渲染异常记录分页控件，与补录记录分页互不影响
     */
    function renderAnomalyPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {
        var total = totalCount || 0;
        anomalyPage = currentPage || 1;
        anomalySize = pageSize || anomalySize;
        var pages = total === 0 ? 1 : Math.ceil(total / anomalySize);
        $("#anomaly_pager_info").text("共 " + total + " 条");
        $("#anomaly_pager_page").text("第 " + anomalyPage + " / " + pages + " 页");
        $("#btn_prev_anomaly_page").prop("disabled", anomalyPage <= 1);
        $("#btn_next_anomaly_page").prop("disabled", anomalyPage >= pages);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染命中异常规则且尚未裁定的服务记录
     */
    function renderAnomalies(records) {
        var $body = $("#anomaly_table").empty();
        if (!records || records.length === 0) {
            $body.append('<tr><td colspan="9" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(records, function (index, record) {
            var anomalyName = record.checkinAnomalyname || record.checkinAnomaly || "—";
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 405 页
            html += `<tr>
                        <td>${record.volunteerName || "—"}
                            <span class="d-block text-muted small">${record.volunteerId || ""} ${record.volunteerTel || ""}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td>${record.activityName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${record.organizationName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(record.checkinBegintime)}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(record.checkinEndtime)}</td>
                        <td>${record.checkinDuration || 0}</td>
                        <td><span class="badge badge-danger">${anomalyName}</span></td>
                        <td>${record.checkinTimecheckText || "待复核"}</td>
                        <td>
                            <div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="异常时长裁定">
                                <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                        onclick="openAnomaly(${record.checkinNum},1)">维持计入</button>
                                <button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" type="button"
                                        onclick="openAnomaly(${record.checkinNum},2)">冲销</button>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 按当前分页与关键字查询待裁定的异常记录
     */
    function loadAnomalies() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/review/anomalies",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": anomalyPage,
                "size": anomalySize,
                "keyword": anomalyKeyword
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "异常记录加载失败");
                    return;
                }
                renderAnomalies(result.extend.list);
                renderAnomalyPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("异常记录加载失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 打开异常时长裁定弹窗，isPass 为 1 维持计入、2 冲销
     */
    function openAnomaly(checkinNum, isPass) {
        anomalyTarget.checkinNum = checkinNum;
        anomalyTarget.isPass = isPass;
        $("#anomaly_information").text("正在裁定的服务记录：签到编号 " + checkinNum
            + "，裁定结果：" + (isPass === 1 ? "维持计入" : "冲销"));
        $("#anomaly_remark").val("");
        if (!anomalyModal) {
            anomalyModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("anomalyModal"));
        }
        anomalyModal.show();
    }

    /**
     * 提交异常时长裁定，成功后刷新异常待裁定列表
     */
    function submitAnomaly() {
        if (anomalyTarget.checkinNum === null) {
            alert("请先选择需要裁定的异常记录");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/review/manualHours/check",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "checkinNum": anomalyTarget.checkinNum,
                "isPass": anomalyTarget.isPass,
                "remark": $.trim($("#anomaly_remark").val())
            },
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "裁定已完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    if (anomalyModal) {
                        anomalyModal.hide();
                    }
                    anomalyTarget.checkinNum = null;
                    anomalyTarget.isPass = null;
                    loadAnomalies();
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("裁定提交失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 点击查询：按关键字与复核状态从第一页开始检索
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 407 页
     */
    $("#btn_search_manual").click(function () {

        state = $("#manual_state").val();
        page = 1;
        loadManualHours();
    });

    /**

        $("#btn_search_manual").click();
    });

    /**
     * 点击重置：清空关键字与状态筛选

    $("#btn_reset_manual").click(function () {
        $("#manual_keyword").val("");
        $("#manual_state").val("");
        keyword = "";
        state = "";
        page = 1;
        loadManualHours();

    /**

    /**

            page = page - 1;

    });

    $("#btn_next_page").click(function () {

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 当前页码、每页条数与检索关键字
     */
    var page = 1;
    var size = 10;
    var keyword = "";

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd
     */
    function formatDate(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 10);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染分页控件：共 N 条、第 X / Y 页，首页禁用上一页、末页禁用下一页
     */
    function renderPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {
        var total = totalCount || 0;
        page = currentPage || 1;
        size = pageSize || size;
        var pages = total === 0 ? 1 : Math.ceil(total / size);
        $("#pager_info").text("共 " + total + " 条");
        $("#pager_page").text("第 " + page + " / " + pages + " 页");
        $("#btn_prev_page").prop("disabled", page <= 1);
        $("#btn_next_page").prop("disabled", page >= pages);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染组织账号列表
     */
    function renderOrganizations(organizations) {
        var $body = $("#org_table").empty();
        if (!organizations || organizations.length === 0) {
            $body.append('<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(organizations, function (index, organization) {
            var enabled = organization.accountEnabled === 1;
            html += `<tr>
                        <td>${organization.organizationId || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${organization.organizationName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${formatDate(organization.organizationEstablishdate)}</td>
                        <td>${organization.organizationIntroduction || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${organization.activityCount || 0}</td>
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 416 页
                        <td>${enabled ? '<span class="badge badge-success">启用</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-secondary">停用</span>'}</td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                    onclick="toggleEnabled('${organization.organizationId}', ${enabled ? 0 : 1})">${enabled ? "停用" : "启用"}</button>
                            <button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-warning btn-sm" type="button"
                                    onclick="resetPassword('${organization.organizationId}')">重置密码</button>
                        </td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 按当前分页与关键字查询组织账号名单
     */
    function loadOrganizations() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/account/organizations",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": page,
                "size": size,
                "keyword": keyword
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "组织名单加载失败");
                    return;
                }
                renderOrganizations(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("组织名单加载失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 展示一次性密码：初始密码与重置后的新密码只在弹窗中展示
     */
    function showOneTimePassword(title, msg, password) {
        $("#password_title").text(title);
        $("#password_msg").text(msg || "");
        $("#password_value").text(password);
        new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("passwordModal")).show();
    }

    /**
     * 开通志愿者组织账号，平台生成的初始密码通过弹窗一次性展示
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 417 页
     */
    $("#btn_create_org").click(function () {
        var organizationId = $.trim($("#org_id").val());
        var organizationName = $.trim($("#org_name").val());
        if (!organizationId) {
            alert("请填写组织登录账号");
            return;
        }
        if (!organizationName) {
            alert("请填写组织名称");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/account/organization/create",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "organizationId": organizationId,
                "organizationName": organizationName,
                "password": $.trim($("#org_password").val()),
                "establishDate": $("#org_establishdate").val(),
                "description": $.trim($("#org_introduction").val())
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    if (result.extend && result.extend.password) {
                        showOneTimePassword("组织账号开通成功", result.msg, result.extend.password);
                    } else {
                        alert(result.msg || "组织账号开通成功");
                    }
                    $("#org_id").val("");
                    $("#org_name").val("");
                    $("#org_password").val("");
                    $("#org_establishdate").val("");
                    $("#org_introduction").val("");
                    page = 1;
                    loadOrganizations();
                } else {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "组织账号开通失败");
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("组织账号开通失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    });

    /**
     * 清空开通表单
     */
    $("#btn_clear_org").click(function () {

        $("#org_id").val("");
        $("#org_name").val("");

            },

    function resetPassword(accountId) {

            return;

        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/account/password/reset",
            type: "POST",

            },

                if (result && result.code === 100 && result.extend && result.extend.password) {
                    showOneTimePassword("密码重置成功", result.msg, result.extend.password);
                    loadOrganizations();
                } else {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "密码重置失败");
                }

    /**
     * 当前页码、每页条数与检索关键字
     */
    var page = 1;
    var size = 10;
    var keyword = "";

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染分页控件：共 N 条、第 X / Y 页，首页禁用上一页、末页禁用下一页
     */
    function renderPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {
        var total = totalCount || 0;
        page = currentPage || 1;
        size = pageSize || size;
        var pages = total === 0 ? 1 : Math.ceil(total / size);
        $("#pager_info").text("共 " + total + " 条");
        $("#pager_page").text("第 " + page + " / " + pages + " 页");
        $("#btn_prev_page").prop("disabled", page <= 1);
        $("#btn_next_page").prop("disabled", page >= pages);
    }

E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 425 页
    /**
     * 渲染志愿秀列表
     */
    function renderShows(shows) {
        var $body = $("#show_table").empty();
        if (!shows || shows.length === 0) {
            $body.append('<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(shows, function (index, show) {
            html += `<tr>
                        <td>${show.volunteerName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${show.activityName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${show.showDetail || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${show.showBrowse || 0}</td>
                        <td>${show.showLike || 0}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(show.showSharetime)}</td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-danger btn-sm" type="button"
                                    onclick="deleteShow(${show.showNum})">删除</button>
                        </td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 按当前分页与关键字查询志愿秀
     */
    function loadShows() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/review/shows",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": page,
                "size": size,
                "keyword": keyword
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "志愿秀加载失败");
                    return;
                }
                renderShows(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("志愿秀加载失败，请稍后重试");
            }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 426 页
        });
    }

    /**
     * 删除志愿秀，确认后调用删除接口
     */
    function deleteShow(showNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定删除该条志愿秀吗？删除后门户不再展示。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/review/show/delete",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "showNum": showNum
            },
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "志愿秀删除已完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    loadShows();
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("志愿秀删除失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 点击查询：关键字检索从第一页开始
     */
    $("#btn_search_show").click(function () {
        keyword = $.trim($("#show_keyword").val());
        page = 1;
        loadShows();
    });

     */
    $("#btn_reset_show").click(function () {
        $("#show_keyword").val("");
        keyword = "";
        page = 1;
        loadShows();
    });

    /**
     * 回车即查询
     */

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 当前页码、每页条数与检索关键字
     */
    var page = 1;
    var size = 10;
    var keyword = "";

    /**
     * 渲染分页控件：共 N 条、第 X / Y 页，首页禁用上一页、末页禁用下一页
     */
    function renderPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {
        var total = totalCount || 0;
        page = currentPage || 1;
        size = pageSize || size;
        var pages = total === 0 ? 1 : Math.ceil(total / size);
        $("#pager_info").text("共 " + total + " 条");
        $("#pager_page").text("第 " + page + " / " + pages + " 页");
        $("#btn_prev_page").prop("disabled", page <= 1);
        $("#btn_next_page").prop("disabled", page >= pages);
    }

    /**
     * 同步导出链接上的检索关键字，导出结果与当前名单检索条件一致
     */
    function refreshExportLink() {
        var url = "/admin/account/export/volunteers";
        if (keyword) {
            url = url + "?keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(keyword);
        }
        $("#btn_export_volunteers").attr("href", url);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染志愿者名单
     */
    function renderVolunteers(volunteers) {
        var $body = $("#volunteer_table").empty();
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 437 页
        if (!volunteers || volunteers.length === 0) {
            $body.append('<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(volunteers, function (index, volunteer) {
            var enabled = volunteer.accountEnabled === 1;
            html += `<tr>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerId || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerTel || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerCredit || 0}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerTotalduration || 0}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerNoshow || 0}</td>
                        <td>${enabled ? '<span class="badge badge-success">启用</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-secondary">停用</span>'}</td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                    onclick="toggleEnabled('${volunteer.volunteerId}', ${enabled ? 0 : 1})">${enabled ? "停用" : "启用"}</button>
                            <button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-warning btn-sm" type="button"
                                    onclick="resetPassword('${volunteer.volunteerId}')">重置密码</button>
                        </td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 按当前分页与关键字查询志愿者名单
     */
    function loadVolunteers() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/account/volunteers",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": page,
                "size": size,
                "keyword": keyword
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "志愿者名单加载失败");
                    return;
                }
                renderVolunteers(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("志愿者名单加载失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 438 页
    }

    /**
     * 展示一次性密码：重置后的新密码只在弹窗中展示
     */
    function showOneTimePassword(title, msg, password) {
        $("#password_title").text(title);
        $("#password_msg").text(msg || "");
        $("#password_value").text(password);
        new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("passwordModal")).show();
    }

    /**
     * 启用或停用志愿者账号
     */
    function toggleEnabled(accountId, enabled) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/account/enabled",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "accountId": accountId,
                "enabled": enabled
            },
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作已完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    loadVolunteers();
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("账号状态修改失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 重置志愿者账号密码，重置后的新密码通过弹窗一次性展示
     */
    function resetPassword(accountId) {
        if (!confirm("确定重置账号 " + accountId + " 的登录密码吗？")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/account/password/reset",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "accountId": accountId
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result && result.code === 100 && result.extend && result.extend.password) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 439 页
                    showOneTimePassword("密码重置成功", result.msg, result.extend.password);
                    loadVolunteers();
                } else {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "密码重置失败");
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("密码重置失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 点击查询：关键字检索从第一页开始
     */
    $("#btn_search_volunteer").click(function () {
        keyword = $.trim($("#volunteer_keyword").val());
        page = 1;
        refreshExportLink();
        loadVolunteers();
    });

    /**
     * 点击重置：清空关键字并回到第一页
     */
    $("#btn_reset_volunteer").click(function () {
        $("#volunteer_keyword").val("");
        keyword = "";
        page = 1;
        refreshExportLink();
        loadVolunteers();
    });

    /**
     * 回车即查询
     */
    $("#volunteer_keyword").keydown(function (event) {
        if (event.keyCode === 13) {
            $("#btn_search_volunteer").click();
        }
    });

    /**
     * 分页按钮
     */
    $("#btn_prev_page").click(function () {
        if (page > 1) {
            page = page - 1;
            loadVolunteers();
        }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 440 页
    });

    $("#btn_next_page").click(function () {
        page = page + 1;
        loadVolunteers();
    });

    /**
     * 进入页面即加载志愿者名单
     */
    $(document).ready(function () {
        refreshExportLink();
        loadVolunteers();
    });
</script>

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 446 页
    /**
     * 将时间转换为 datetime-local 输入框需要的 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm
     */
    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将 datetime-local 输入框的值转换为接口需要的 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    /**
     * 通用分页控件渲染：holderId 为分页容器编号，onChange 接收目标页码
     */
    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 447 页

    /**
     * 分页响应统一取值：list 当前页数据、total 总条数、page 当前页、size 每页条数
     */
    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    /**
     * 统一提示文案：优先使用接口返回的 msg，纯文本响应直接展示
     */
    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    /**
     * 查询顶部未读消息数量
     */
    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /** 当前页码、每页条数与检索关键字 */
    var page = 1, size = 10, keyword = "";
    /** 活动详情模态框实例 */
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 448 页
    var activityModal = null;

    /**
     * 渲染审核中的活动列表
     */
    function renderActivityTable(list) {
        var tabValue = "";
        $.each(list, function (index, item) {
            tabValue += `<tr>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityName}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityBegintime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityEndtime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityLocation || "—"}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">
                                <div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="活动操作">
                                    <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                            onclick="activityInfo(${item.activityNum})">查看详情</button>
                                    <button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" type="button"
                                            onclick="auditActivityDelete(${item.activityNum})">删除</button>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                         </tr>`;
        });
        if (list.length === 0) {
            tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
        }
        $("#activity_table tbody").html(tabValue);
    }

    /**
     * 加载当前组织的审核中活动
     */
    function load() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/findAuditActivityByNumAndState",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: page, size: size, keyword: keyword},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                renderActivityTable(data.list);
                renderPager("activity_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    load();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 449 页
    }

    /**
     * 查看活动详情
     */
    function activityInfo(activityNum) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/activityInfo",
            type: "GET",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var actInfo = (result && result.extend && result.extend.activityInfo)
                    ? result.extend.activityInfo[0] : null;
                if (!actInfo) {
                    alert(tip(result, "活动详情加载失败"));
                    return;
                }
                $("#actvity_name").val(actInfo.activityName);
                $("#actvity_detail").val(actInfo.activityDetail);
                $("#actvity_begintime").val(formatTime(actInfo.activityBegintime));
                $("#actvity_endtime").val(formatTime(actInfo.activityEndtime));
                $("#actvity_signddl").val(formatTime(actInfo.activitySignddl));
                $("#actvity_location").val(actInfo.activityLocation);
                $("#actvity_needpeople").val(actInfo.activityNeedpeople);
                $("#actvity_notice").val(actInfo.activityNotice);
                if (!activityModal) {
                    activityModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("activityModal"));
                }
                activityModal.show();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 删除审核中的活动，删除后重新加载当前页
     */
    function auditActivityDelete(activityNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定删除该活动吗？删除后不可恢复。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/auditActivityDelete",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "删除成功" : "删除失败"));
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 450 页
                if (success) {
                    load();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadUnreadCount();
        load();
        $("#search_button").click(function () {
            page = 1;
            keyword = $.trim($("#keyword").val());
            load();
        });
    });

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将时间转换为 datetime-local 输入框需要的 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm
     */
    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 455 页
     * 将 datetime-local 输入框的值转换为接口需要的 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    /**
     * 通用分页控件渲染：holderId 为分页容器编号，onChange 接收目标页码
     */
    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 分页响应统一取值：list 当前页数据、total 总条数、page 当前页、size 每页条数
     */
    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 456 页
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    /**
     * 统一提示文案：优先使用接口返回的 msg，纯文本响应直接展示
     */
    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    /**
     * 查询顶部未读消息数量
     */
    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /** 当前页码、每页条数与检索关键字 */
    var page = 1, size = 10, keyword = "";

    /**
     * 渲染进行中的活动列表
     */
    function renderActivityTable(list) {
        var tabValue = "";
        $.each(list, function (index, item) {
            tabValue += `<tr>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityName}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityBegintime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityEndtime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityLocation || "—"}</td>
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 457 页
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">
                                <div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="活动操作">
                                    <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                            onclick="finishActivity(${item.activityNum})">结束活动</button>
                                    <a class="btn btn-outline-success btn-sm"
                                       href="/org/export/participants?activityNum=${item.activityNum}">导出报名名单</a>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                         </tr>`;
        });
        if (list.length === 0) {
            tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
        }
        $("#activity_table tbody").html(tabValue);
    }

    /**
     * 加载当前组织进行中的活动
     */
    function load() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/findCarryActivityByNumAndState",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: page, size: size, keyword: keyword},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                renderActivityTable(data.list);
                renderPager("activity_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    load();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 结束活动：活动置为已结束，之后可进行活动结算
     */
    function finishActivity(activityNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定结束该活动吗？结束后志愿者不能继续签到。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/finishActivity",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 458 页
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "活动已结束" : "活动结束失败"));
                if (success) {
                    load();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadUnreadCount();
        load();
        $("#search_button").click(function () {
            page = 1;
            keyword = $.trim($("#keyword").val());
            load();
        });
    });

</script>

            type: "GET",

                console.log(result);

     */

    function settleActivity(activityNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定对该活动进行结算吗？结算后将记录未签到志愿者的爽约情况。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/settle",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "活动结算完成" : "活动结算失败"));
                if (success) {
                    load();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

        load();
        $("#search_button").click(function () {
            page = 1;
            keyword = $.trim($("#keyword").val());
            load();
        });
    });

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将时间转换为 datetime-local 输入框需要的 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm
     */
    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将 datetime-local 输入框的值转换为接口需要的 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    /**
     * 通用分页控件渲染：holderId 为分页容器编号，onChange 接收目标页码
     */
    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 472 页
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 分页响应统一取值：list 当前页数据、total 总条数、page 当前页、size 每页条数
     */
    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将时间转换为 datetime-local 输入框需要的 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm
     */
    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 485 页
    /**
     * 将 datetime-local 输入框的值转换为接口需要的 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    /**
     * 通用分页控件渲染：holderId 为分页容器编号，onChange 接收目标页码
     */
    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 分页响应统一取值：list 当前页数据、total 总条数、page 当前页、size 每页条数
     */
    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 486 页
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    /**
     * 统一提示文案：优先使用接口返回的 msg，纯文本响应直接展示
     */
    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    /**
     * 查询顶部未读消息数量
     */
    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });

    /**

    /**
     * 审核状态文案

    function applyStateText(state) {
        if (state === "0") {
            return "待审核";
        }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 489 页
        if (state === "1") {
            return '<span style="color: #009900">已通过</span>';
        }
        if (state === "2") {
            return '<span style="color: red">未通过</span>';
        }
        if (state === "3") {
            return "候补";
        }
        return "—";
    }

    /**
     * 报名操作列：待审核可审核，已通过可移除报名，其余仅展示状态

    function recruitControlHtml(item) {
        var buttons = "";
        if (item.participateApplystate === "0" || item.participateApplystate === "3") {
            buttons += `<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                onclick="volPassRecruit(${item.participateNum})">通过</button>
                        <button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" type="button"
                                onclick="volUnPassRecruit(${item.participateNum})">驳回</button>`;
        }
        if (item.participateApplystate === "0" || item.participateApplystate === "1"
            || item.participateApplystate === "3") {
            buttons += `<button class="btn btn-outline-warning btn-sm" type="button"
                                onclick="removeParticipate(${item.participateNum})">移除报名</button>`;
        }
        if (!buttons) {
            return "—";
        }
        return `<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="报名操作">${buttons}</div>`;
    }

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将时间转换为 datetime-local 输入框需要的 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm
     */
    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将 datetime-local 输入框的值转换为接口需要的 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 498 页
    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    /**

     */
    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 分页响应统一取值：list 当前页数据、total 总条数、page 当前页、size 每页条数
     */
    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 499 页
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    /**
     * 统一提示文案：优先使用接口返回的 msg，纯文本响应直接展示
     */
    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    /**
     * 查询顶部未读消息数量
     */
    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    var page = 1, size = 10, activityNum = "";
    /** 公告编号与公告信息的对应关系 */
    var announcements = {};
    /** 公告表单模态框实例 */
    var announcementModal = null;

    function loadActivityOptions(selector) {

            "/activity/findNotStartActivityByNumAndState",

            "/activity/findEndActivityByNumAndState"

E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 500 页

    /**

    function loadAnnouncements() {

                                                    onclick="deleteAnnouncement(${item.actannouncementNum})">删除</button>
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                 </tr>`;
                });
                if (data.list.length === 0) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 501 页
                    tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
                }

                renderPager("announcement_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {

    /**
     * 打开公告表单：不传公告编号为新增，传入为编辑
     */
    function openAnnouncementModal(announcementNum) {
        var announcement = announcementNum ? announcements[announcementNum] : null;
        $("#announcement_num").val(announcement ? announcement.actannouncementNum : "");
        $("#announcementModalLabel").text(announcement ? "编辑活动公告" : "新增活动公告");
        $("#announcement_name").val(announcement ? announcement.actannouncementName : "");
        $("#announcement_detail").val(announcement ? (announcement.actannouncementDetail || "") : "");
        if (announcement && $("#announcement_activity").find('option[value="' + announcement.activityNum + '"]').length === 0) {
            $("#announcement_activity").append($("<option></option>").val(announcement.activityNum)
                .text(announcement.activityName || ("活动 " + announcement.activityNum)));
        }
        $("#announcement_activity").val(announcement ? announcement.activityNum : ($("#activity_filter").val() || ""));
        if (!announcementModal) {
            announcementModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("announcementModal"));
        }
        announcementModal.show();
    }

    /**
     * 保存活动公告：公告编号为空时新增
     */
    function saveAnnouncement() {
        var activityValue = $("#announcement_activity").val();
        var name = $.trim($("#announcement_name").val());
        var detail = $.trim($("#announcement_detail").val());
        if (!activityValue) {
            alert("请选择公告所属活动");
            return;
        }
        if (!name) {
            alert("请填写公告标题");
            return;
        }
        if (!detail) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 502 页
            alert("请填写公告内容");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/content/announcement/save",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "announcementNum": $("#announcement_num").val(),
                "activityNum": activityValue,
                "name": name,
                "detail": detail
            },
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "活动公告已保存" : "活动公告保存失败"));
                if (success) {
                    if (announcementModal) {
                        announcementModal.hide();
                    }
                    loadAnnouncements();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 删除活动公告
     */
    function deleteAnnouncement(announcementNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定删除该活动公告吗？删除后不可恢复。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/content/announcement/delete",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"announcementNum": announcementNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "活动公告已删除" : "活动公告删除失败"));
                if (success) {
                    loadAnnouncements();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 503 页
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadUnreadCount();
        loadActivityOptions("#activity_filter");
        loadActivityOptions("#announcement_activity");
        loadAnnouncements();
        $("#search_button").click(function () {
            page = 1;
            activityNum = $("#activity_filter").val();
            loadAnnouncements();
        });
        $("#add_announcement_button").click(function () {
            openAnnouncementModal(null);
        });
        $("#announcement_submit").click(function () {
            saveAnnouncement();
        });
    });

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 513 页
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将时间转换为 datetime-local 输入框需要的 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm
     */
    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将 datetime-local 输入框的值转换为接口需要的 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    /**
     * 通用分页控件渲染：holderId 为分页容器编号，onChange 接收目标页码
     */
    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 514 页
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 分页响应统一取值：list 当前页数据、total 总条数、page 当前页、size 每页条数
     */
    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    /**
     * 统一提示文案：优先使用接口返回的 msg，纯文本响应直接展示
     */
    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    function loadActivityList(key) {
        var config = activityLists[key];
        $.ajax({
            url: config.url,
            type: "GET",
            data: {"page": config.page, "size": config.size},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, config.page, config.size);
                var tabValue = "";
                $.each(data.list, function (index, activity) {
                    tabValue += `<tr>
                                    <td>${activity.activityName}</td>
                                    <td>${formatTime(activity.activityBegintime)} ~ ${formatTime(activity.activityEndtime)}</td>
                                    <td>${activity.activityLocation || "—"}</td>
                                    <td>${activity.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>
                                    <td>${activity.activitySettleTime ? "已结算" : "未结算"}</td>
                                    <td>
                                        <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm activity_manage_button" type="button"
                                                data-activity-num="${activity.activityNum}"
                                                data-activity-name="${activity.activityName}"
                                                data-activity-ended="${config.endActivity}">签到与时长管理</button>
                                    </td>
                                 </tr>`;
                });
                if (data.list.length === 0) {
                    tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
                }
                $("#" + config.tableId + " tbody").html(tabValue);
                renderPager(config.pagerId, data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    config.page = target;
                    loadActivityList(key);
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 查询当前活动的现场签到码
     */
    function loadCheckinCode() {
        if (currentActivityNum === null) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/checkin/code",
            type: "GET",
            data: {"activityNum": currentActivityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !extend.checkinCode) {
                    $("#checkin_code").text("尚未生成");
                    checkinCodeRemain = 0;
                    $("#checkin_code_expire").text((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "当前没有生效的签到码");
                    return;
                }
                checkinCodeRemain = Number(extend.expiresInSeconds);
                if (isNaN(checkinCodeRemain) || checkinCodeRemain < 0) {
                    checkinCodeRemain = 0;
                }
                $("#checkin_code").text(extend.checkinCode);
                renderCodeExpire();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 518 页
        });
    }

    /**

     */
    function renderCodeExpire() {
        if (checkinCodeRemain > 0) {
            $("#checkin_code_expire").text("剩余有效 " + checkinCodeRemain + " 秒，到期后自动轮换");
            return;
        }
        $("#checkin_code_expire").text("正在获取当前签到码……");
    }

    /**
     * 签到码倒计时：每秒递减，归零时立即拉取轮换后的签到码
     */
    function tickCheckinCode() {
        if (currentActivityNum === null || checkinCodeRemain <= 0) {
            return;
        }
        checkinCodeRemain = checkinCodeRemain - 1;
        renderCodeExpire();
        if (checkinCodeRemain === 0) {
            loadCheckinCode();
        }
    }

    /**
     * 生成 / 重新生成现场签到码
     */
    function generateCheckinCode(refresh) {
        if (currentActivityNum === null) {
            return;
        }
        if (refresh && !confirm("更换密钥后原签到码立即失效，将立即生成新的签到码，确定更换吗？")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/checkin/code",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"activityNum": currentActivityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "签到码已生成" : "签到码生成失败"));
                if (success) {
                    loadCheckinCode();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 519 页
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

        var confirmButton = confirmSheetButtonHtml(item);

     * 查询当前活动的服务记录
     */
    function loadReviewList() {
        if (currentActivityNum === null) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/checkin/reviewList",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "activityNum": currentActivityNum,
                "page": reviewPage,
                "size": reviewSize,
                "state": reviewState,
                "source": reviewSource
            },
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, reviewPage, reviewSize);
                var tabValue = "";
                $.each(data.list, function (index, item) {
                    var duration = (item.checkinDuration === null || item.checkinDuration === undefined)
                        ? "—" : item.checkinDuration + " 小时";
                    var distance = (item.checkinDistance === null || item.checkinDistance === undefined)
                        ? "—" : item.checkinDistance;
                    tabValue += `<tr>
                                    <td>${item.volunteerId || "—"}</td>
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 522 页
                                    <td>${item.volunteerName || "—"}</td>
                                    <td>${item.volunteerTel || "—"}</td>
                                    <td>${sourceText(item)}</td>
                                    <td>${formatTime(item.checkinBegintime)}</td>
                                    <td>${formatTime(item.checkinEndtime)}</td>
                                    <td>${duration}</td>
                                    <td>${distance}</td>
                                    <td>${checkinFlagText(item.checkinFlag)}</td>
                                    <td>${objectConfirmHtml(item)}</td>
                                    <td>${anomalyHtml(item)}</td>
                                    <td>${reviewStateHtml(item)}</td>
                                    <td>${reviewRemarkText(item)}</td>
                                    <td class="text-center">${reviewControlHtml(item)}</td>
                                 </tr>`;
                });
                if (data.list.length === 0) {
                    tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="14" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
                }
                $("#checkinReview_table tbody").html(tabValue);
                renderPager("review_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    reviewPage = target;
                    loadReviewList();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 活动结算，结算后刷新签到记录与活动列表
     */
    function settleActivity() {
        if (currentActivityNum === null) {
            return;
        }
        if (!confirm("确定对该活动进行结算吗？结算后将记录未签到志愿者的爽约情况。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/settle",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"activityNum": currentActivityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "活动结算完成" : "活动结算失败"));
                if (success) {
                    loadReviewList();
                    reloadActivityLists();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 加载当前活动已通过报名的志愿者，供补录服务时长选择
     */
    function loadManualVolunteers() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/volRecruit",
            type: "GET",
            data: {"activityNum": currentActivityNum, "page": 1, "size": 100},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, 1, 100);
                var $select = $("#manual_participate");
                $select.empty().append('<option value="">请选择已通过报名的志愿者</option>');
                var added = 0;
                $.each(data.list, function (index, item) {
                    if (item.participateApplystate !== "1") {
                        return true;
                    }
                    var volunteer = item.volunteer || {};
                    var label = (volunteer.volunteerName || "志愿者")
                        + "（" + (volunteer.volunteerId || item.volunteerNum) + "）";
                    $select.append($("<option></option>").val(item.participateNum).text(label));
                    added += 1;
                });
                if (added === 0) {
                    $("#manual_hint").text("该活动暂无已通过报名的志愿者，无法补录服务时长").removeClass("d-none");
                } else {
                    $("#manual_hint").text("").addClass("d-none");
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 提交服务时长补录，提交后由平台管理员复核
     */
    function submitManual() {
        var participateNum = $("#manual_participate").val();
        var beginTime = toApiTime($("#manual_begin").val());
        var endTime = toApiTime($("#manual_end").val());
        if (!participateNum) {
            alert("请选择需要补录服务时长的志愿者");
            return;
        }
        if (!beginTime || !endTime) {
            alert("请填写服务开始时间与结束时间");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/checkin/manual",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "participateNum": participateNum,
                "beginTime": beginTime,
                "endTime": endTime,
                "remark": $("#manual_remark").val()
            },
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "服务时长补录成功，等待平台管理员复核" : "服务时长补录失败"));
                if (success) {
                    if (manualModal) {
                        manualModal.hide();
                    }
                    reviewPage = 1;
                    loadReviewList();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }
