    /**
     * 提交服务确认单，成功后在同一弹窗内展示服务确认码
     */
    function submitConfirmSheet() {
        if (confirmSheetTarget === null) {
            alert("请先选择需要生成服务确认单的服务记录");
            return;
        }
        var objectName = $.trim($("#confirm_object_name").val());
        var objectPhone = $.trim($("#confirm_object_phone").val());
        if (!objectName) {
            alert("请填写服务对象名称");
            return;
        }
        if (!/^\d{11}$/.test(objectPhone)) {
            alert("请填写服务对象本人的 11 位手机号");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/checkin/confirmSheet",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "checkinNum": confirmSheetTarget,
                "objectName": objectName,
                "objectPhone": objectPhone
            },
            success: function (result) {
                var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "服务确认单已生成" : "服务确认单生成失败"));
                if (!success || !extend.confirmCode) {
                    return;
                }
                $("#confirm_code_value").text(extend.confirmCode);
                $("#confirm_code_hint").text("请将确认码交由服务对象本人核对手机号后确认本次服务");
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 527 页
                $("#confirm_sheet_form").addClass("d-none");
                $("#confirm_sheet_submit").addClass("d-none");
                $("#confirm_code_area").removeClass("d-none");
                loadReviewList();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 复制服务确认码，浏览器不支持复制命令时提示手动记录
     */
    function copyConfirmCode() {
        var confirmCode = $.trim($("#confirm_code_value").text());
        if (!confirmCode || confirmCode === "—") {
            alert("当前没有可复制的服务确认码");
            return;
        }
        var $temp = $("<textarea></textarea>").val(confirmCode)
            .css({position: "fixed", top: "-1000px"}).appendTo("body");
        $temp[0].select();
        try {
            document.execCommand("copy");
            alert("服务确认码已复制");
        } catch (error) {
            alert("复制失败，请手动记录服务确认码：" + confirmCode);
        }
        $temp.remove();
    }

    /**
     * 通用分页控件渲染：holderId 为分页容器编号，onChange 接收目标页码
     */
    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 分页响应统一取值：list 当前页数据、total 总条数、page 当前页、size 每页条数
     */
    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    /**

    function renderActivityTable(list) {

                            <td>${activity.activityName}</td>
                            <td>${activity.activityLocation || "—"}</td>
                            <td>${formatTime(activity.activityBegintime)}</td>
                            <td>${formatTime(activity.activityEndtime)}</td>
                            <td>${formatTime(activity.activitySignddl)}</td>
                            <td>${activity.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>
                            <td><a class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" href="act_audit.html">查看</a></td>
                         </tr>`;
        });
        if (list.length === 0) {
            tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
        }
        $("#activity_table").html(tabValue);
    }

    /**
     * 加载审核中的活动列表
     */
    function loadActivityList() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/findAuditActivityByNumAndState",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: page, size: size, keyword: keyword},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                renderActivityTable(data.list);
                $("#count_audit").text(data.total);
                renderPager("activity_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    loadActivityList();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function loadOrganization() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/info",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || !result.extend || !result.extend.organization) {
                    return;
                }
                var org = result.extend.organization;
                $("#organization_name").text(org.organizationName);
                $("#organization_name_detail").text(org.organizationName);
                $("#organization_id").text(org.organizationId);
                $("#organization_date").text(formatTime(org.organizationEstablishdate).substring(0, 10));
                $("#organization_introduction").text(org.organizationIntroduction || "—");
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

        loadOrganization();

            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                var tabValue = "";
                $.each(data.list, function (index, item) {
                    var unread = isUnread(item.notificationRead);
                    var stateHtml = unread
                        ? '<span class="badge bg-primary">未读</span>'
                        : '<span class="badge bg-secondary">已读</span>';
                    var titleHtml = unread
                        ? '<span class="f-w-600">' + item.notificationTitle + '</span>'
                        : (item.notificationTitle || "—");
                    var controlHtml = unread
                        ? '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button" onclick="markRead('
                            + item.notificationNum + ')">标记已读</button>'
                        : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';
                    tabValue += `<tr>
                                    <td>${stateHtml}</td>
                                    <td>${titleHtml}</td>
                                    <td>${item.notificationDetail || "—"}</td>
                                    <td>${formatTime(item.notificationTime)}</td>
                                    <td>${controlHtml}</td>
                                 </tr>`;
                });
                if (data.list.length === 0) {
                    tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
                }
                $("#notification_table tbody").html(tabValue);
                renderPager("notification_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    loadNotifications();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 546 页

    /**
     * 将单条通知标记为已读
     */
    function markRead(notificationNum) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/read",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"notificationNum": notificationNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "通知已标记为已读" : "标记已读失败"));
                if (success) {
                    loadNotifications();
                    loadUnreadCount();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 将全部通知标记为已读
     */
    function readAll() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/readAll",
            type: "POST",
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "已全部标记为已读" : "操作失败"));
                if (success) {
                    page = 1;
                    loadNotifications();
                    loadUnreadCount();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

        loadUnreadCount();
        loadNotifications();
        $("#read_all_button").click(function () {
            readAll();

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将时间转换为 datetime-local 输入框需要的 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm
     */
    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 560 页
     * 将 datetime-local 输入框的值转换为接口需要的 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    /**
     * 通用分页控件渲染：holderId 为分页容器编号，onChange 接收目标页码
     */
    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 分页响应统一取值：list 当前页数据、total 总条数、page 当前页、size 每页条数
     */
    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 561 页
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    /**
     * 统一提示文案：优先使用接口返回的 msg，纯文本响应直接展示
     */
    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    /**

    function loadUnreadCount() {

            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function loadActivityOptions(selector) {
        var urls = [
            "/activity/findNotStartActivityByNumAndState",
            "/activity/findCarryActivityByNumAndState",
            "/activity/findEndActivityByNumAndState"
        ];
        $.each(urls, function (index, url) {
            $.ajax({
                url: url,
                type: "GET",
                data: {"page": 1, "size": 100},
                success: function (result) {
                    var data = pageData(result, 1, 100);
                    var $select = $(selector);
                    $.each(data.list, function (i, activity) {
                        if ($select.find('option[value="' + activity.activityNum + '"]').length === 0) {
                            $select.append($("<option></option>").val(activity.activityNum)
                                .text(activity.activityName));
                        }
                    });
                },
                error: function (result) {
                    console.log(result);
                }
            });
        });
    }

    /**
     * 打开培训表单：不传培训编号为新增，传入为编辑

    function openTrainingModal(trainingNum) {
        var training = trainingNum ? trainings[trainingNum] : null;
        $("#training_num").val(training ? training.trainingNum : "");
        $("#trainingModalLabel").text(training ? "编辑培训安排" : "新增培训安排");
        $("#training_name").val(training ? training.trainingName : "");
        $("#training_detail").val(training ? (training.trainingDetail || "") : "");
        $("#training_begin").val(training ? toDateTimeInput(training.trainingBegintime) : "");
        $("#training_end").val(training ? toDateTimeInput(training.trainingEndtime) : "");
        $("#training_location").val(training ? (training.trainingLocation || "") : "");
        $("#training_checkin").val(training ? (training.trainingCheckin || "") : "");
        if (training && $("#training_activity").find('option[value="' + training.activityNum + '"]').length === 0) {
            $("#training_activity").append($("<option></option>").val(training.activityNum)
                .text(training.activityName || ("活动 " + training.activityNum)));
        }
        $("#training_activity").val(training ? training.activityNum : ($("#activity_filter").val() || ""));
        if (!trainingModal) {
            trainingModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("trainingModal"));
        }
        trainingModal.show();
    }

    /**
     * 保存培训安排：培训编号为空时新增
     */
    function saveTraining() {
        var activityValue = $("#training_activity").val();
        var name = $.trim($("#training_name").val());
        var beginTime = toApiTime($("#training_begin").val());
        var endTime = toApiTime($("#training_end").val());
        if (!activityValue) {
            alert("请选择培训所属活动");
            return;
        }
        if (!name) {
            alert("请填写培训名称");
            return;
        }
        if (!beginTime || !endTime) {
            alert("请填写培训开始时间与结束时间");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/content/training/save",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "trainingNum": $("#training_num").val(),
                "activityNum": activityValue,
                "name": name,
                "detail": $("#training_detail").val(),
                "beginTime": beginTime,
                "endTime": endTime,
                "location": $("#training_location").val(),
                "checkin": $("#training_checkin").val()
            },
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "培训安排已保存" : "培训安排保存失败"));
                if (success) {
                    if (trainingModal) {
                        trainingModal.hide();
                    }
                    loadTrainings();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 565 页
    /**
     * 删除培训安排
     */
    function deleteTraining(trainingNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定删除该培训安排吗？删除后不可恢复。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/content/training/delete",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"trainingNum": trainingNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "培训安排已删除" : "培训安排删除失败"));
                if (success) {
                    loadTrainings();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**

    function loadSituationVolunteers() {
        var training = trainings[currentTrainingNum] || {};
        if (!training.activityNum) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 566 页
            return;

        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/volRecruit",

            data: {"activityNum": training.activityNum, "page": 1, "size": 100},
            success: function (result) {

                var $select = $("#situation_volunteer");
                var added = 0;
                $.each(data.list, function (index, item) {

                });
                if (added === 0) {
                    $("#situation_hint").text("该培训所属活动暂无已通过报名的志愿者").removeClass("d-none");
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {

            }
        });
    }

<script type="text/javascript">

    $("#activity_name").blur(function () {
        var name = $("#activity_name").val();
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/checkname",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "name": name
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    $("#sp").val("");
                    $("#sp").html("   √   ").css("color", "green");
                } else {
                    $("#sp").val("");
                    $("#sp").html("   活动名称重复   ").css("color", "red");
                }
            }
        })
    });

    $("#upactivity_submit").click(function () {
        var name = $("#activity_name").val();
        var content = $("#activity_content").val();
        var startTime = $("#start_time").val();
        var endTime = $("#end_time").val();
        var location = $("#activity_location").val();
        var affair = $("#activity_affair").val();
        var need = $("#activity_need").val();
        var sign_ddl = $("#sign_ddl").val();
        var tags = collectSkillTags();
        var latitude = $("#activity_latitude").val();
        var longitude = $("#activity_longitude").val();
        var radius = $("#activity_radius").val();

        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/upact",
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 576 页
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "name": name,
                "content": content,
                "startTime": startTime,
                "endTime": endTime,
                "location": location,
                "affair": affair,
                "need": need,
                "sign_ddl": sign_ddl,
                "tags": tags,
                "latitude": latitude,
                "longitude": longitude,
                "radius": radius
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    alert(result);
                    window.location.href = "act_audit.html";
                } else {
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        })
    })

    /**
     * 收集表单中选中的服务技能标签，使用英文逗号连接
     */
    function collectSkillTags() {
        var tags = [];
        $(".skill_checkbox:checked").each(function () {
            tags.push($(this).val());
        });
        return tags.join(",");
    }

    /**
     * 使用浏览器定位填充活动地点的纬度与经度
     */
    $("#locate_activity").click(function () {
        if (!navigator.geolocation) {
            alert("当前浏览器不支持定位功能，请手动填写活动定位");
            return;
        }
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function (position) {
            $("#activity_latitude").val(position.coords.latitude.toFixed(6));
            $("#activity_longitude").val(position.coords.longitude.toFixed(6));
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 577 页
        }, function () {
            alert("定位失败，请检查浏览器定位权限后重试");
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 门户首页脚本：通知公告、近期志愿活动、志愿者组织三个区块全部取自 /portal/site/** 公开接口，
     * 接口不可用或没有数据时统一降级为“暂无数据”提示，页面不保留任何写死的业务数据。
     */
    // HTML 转义，避免公告标题、活动名称中的特殊字符破坏页面结构
    function portalEscapeHtml(value) {
        if (value === null || value === undefined) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    // 文本摘要：超过指定长度时截断并追加省略号
    function portalSummary(value, length) {
        var text = value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value);
        return text.length > length ? text.substring(0, length) + "…" : text;
    }

    // 统一时间显示格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
    function portalFormatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    // 从统一响应体中取出当前页列表，缺字段时按空列表处理
    function portalListOf(result) {
        return result && result.extend && result.extend.list ? result.extend.list : [];
    }

    // 区块无数据时渲染“暂无数据”
    function portalEmptyTip(container, message) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="col-12"><p class="text-muted">'
            + portalEscapeHtml(message) + '</p></div>';
    }

    // 活动状态文案，与后端 activity_state 取值保持一致
    var PORTAL_ACTIVITY_STATE = {"1": "未开始", "2": "进行中"};

    // 通知公告区块：展示最近 5 条公告，点击标题查看详情
    function portalLoadAnnouncements() {
        var container = document.getElementById("announcementList");
        fetch("/portal/site/announcements?page=1&size=5").then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            var list = portalListOf(result);
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 583 页
            if (!list.length) {
                portalEmptyTip(container, "暂无数据");
                return;
            }
            var html = "";
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                var announcement = list[i];
                html += '<div class="col-12"><div class="card"><div class="card-body">'
                    + '<h4 class="card-title"><a href="javascript:void(0)" class="portal-announcement-link" data-num="'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(announcement.policyannouncementNum) + '">'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(announcement.policyannouncementName) + '</a></h4>'
                    + '<p>' + portalEscapeHtml(portalSummary(announcement.policyannouncementDetail, 80)) + '</p>'
                    + '<p class="text-muted">附件 ' + Number(announcement.fileCount || 0) + ' 个</p>'
                    + '</div></div></div>';
            }
            container.innerHTML = html;
            var links = container.querySelectorAll(".portal-announcement-link");
            for (var j = 0; j < links.length; j++) {
                links[j].addEventListener("click", function () {
                    portalShowAnnouncement(this.getAttribute("data-num"));
                });
            }
        }).catch(function () {
            portalEmptyTip(container, "暂无数据");
        });
    }

    // 公告详情：展示公告内容与附件下载链接
    function portalShowAnnouncement(policyannouncementNum) {
        fetch("/portal/site/announcement?policyannouncementNum=" + encodeURIComponent(policyannouncementNum))
            .then(function (response) {
                return response.json();
            }).then(function (result) {
                var announcement = result.extend ? result.extend.announcement : null;
                if (result.code !== 100 || !announcement) {
                    alert(result.msg || "该通知公告不存在或已被删除");
                    return;
                }
                var files = announcement.files ? announcement.files : [];
                var fileHtml = "";
                if (files.length) {
                    fileHtml = '<ul class="list">';
                    for (var i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
                        fileHtml += '<li><a href="' + portalEscapeHtml(files[i].policyfileRoute) + '">'
                            + portalEscapeHtml(files[i].policyfileName) + '</a></li>';
                    }
                    fileHtml += '</ul>';
                } else {
                    fileHtml = '<p class="text-muted">该公告没有附件</p>';
                }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 584 页
                portalOpenModal(announcement.policyannouncementName,
                    '<p>' + portalEscapeHtml(announcement.policyannouncementDetail).replace(/\n/g, "<br>") + '</p>'
                    + '<h4>附件下载</h4>' + fileHtml);
            }).catch(function () {
                alert("通知公告详情加载失败，请稍后重试");
            });
    }

    // 近期志愿活动区块：展示活动名称、时间、地点、招募人数与状态
    function portalLoadActivities() {
        var container = document.getElementById("activityList");
        fetch("/portal/site/activities?page=1&size=6").then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            var list = portalListOf(result);
            if (!list.length) {
                portalEmptyTip(container, "暂无数据");
                return;
            }
            var html = "";
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                var activity = list[i];
                html += '<div class="col-md-6 col-lg-4"><div class="card"><div class="card-body">'
                    + '<h4 class="card-title">' + portalEscapeHtml(activity.activityName) + '</h4>'
                    + '<ul class="list">'
                    + '<li>活动时间：' + portalEscapeHtml(portalFormatTime(activity.activityBegintime))
                    + ' 至 ' + portalEscapeHtml(portalFormatTime(activity.activityEndtime)) + '</li>'
                    + '<li>活动地点：' + portalEscapeHtml(activity.activityLocation || "—") + '</li>'
                    + '<li>招募人数：' + Number(activity.activityNeedpeople || 0) + ' 人</li>'
                    + '<li>报名截止：' + portalEscapeHtml(portalFormatTime(activity.activitySignddl)) + '</li>'
                    + '<li>活动状态：'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(PORTAL_ACTIVITY_STATE[activity.activityState] || "—") + '</li>'
                    + '</ul>'
                    + '<p>' + portalEscapeHtml(portalSummary(activity.activityDetail, 60)) + '</p>'
                    + '</div></div></div>';
            }
            container.innerHTML = html;
        }).catch(function () {
            portalEmptyTip(container, "暂无数据");
        });
    }

    // 志愿者组织区块：展示组织名称、成立日期与组织简介
    function portalLoadOrganizations() {
        var container = document.getElementById("organizationList");
        fetch("/portal/site/organizations?page=1&size=6").then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            var list = portalListOf(result);
            if (!list.length) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 585 页
                portalEmptyTip(container, "暂无数据");
                return;
            }
            var html = "";
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                var organization = list[i];
                html += '<div class="col-md-6 col-lg-4"><div class="card"><div class="card-body">'
                    + '<h4 class="card-title">' + portalEscapeHtml(organization.organizationName) + '</h4>'
                    + '<p class="text-muted">成立日期：'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(portalFormatTime(organization.organizationEstablishdate)) + '</p>'
                    + '<p>' + portalEscapeHtml(portalSummary(organization.organizationIntroduction, 60)) + '</p>'
                    + '</div></div></div>';
            }
            container.innerHTML = html;
        }).catch(function () {
            portalEmptyTip(container, "暂无数据");
        });
    }

    // 弹窗打开与关闭
    function portalOpenModal(title, bodyHtml) {
        document.getElementById("portalModalTitle").textContent = title || "";
        document.getElementById("portalModalBody").innerHTML = bodyHtml;
        document.getElementById("portalModal").style.display = "block";
    }

    function portalCloseModal() {
        document.getElementById("portalModal").style.display = "none";
    }

    document.getElementById("portalModalClose").addEventListener("click", portalCloseModal);
    document.getElementById("portalModal").addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (event.target === this) {
            portalCloseModal();
        }
    });

    portalLoadAnnouncements();
    portalLoadActivities();
    portalLoadOrganizations();
</script>

    //成功时按“确认 / 否认”用绿色、橙色区隔展示接口返回的提示信息
    function showConfirmResult(msg, isConfirmed) {
        var box = document.getElementById("confirmResult");
        box.innerHTML = `<div class="alert ${isConfirmed ? "alert-success" : "alert-warning"}" role="alert">
                            <h4 class="card-title" id="confirmResultTitle"></h4>
                            <p class="mb-0" id="confirmResultMsg"></p>
                        </div>`;
        document.getElementById("confirmResultTitle").textContent = isConfirmed ? "服务确认成功" : "服务否认已记录";
        document.getElementById("confirmResultMsg").textContent = msg;
    }

    //失败或接口异常时展示接口返回的提示信息
    function showConfirmError(msg) {
        var box = document.getElementById("confirmResult");
        box.innerHTML = `<div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">
                            <h4 class="card-title">服务确认未完成</h4>
                            <p class="mb-0" id="confirmResultError"></p>
                        </div>`;
        document.getElementById("confirmResultError").textContent = msg;
    }

    document.getElementById("confirmForm").addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var resultInput = document.querySelector('input[name="resultValue"]:checked');
        var resultValue = resultInput ? resultInput.value : "";
        var data = new URLSearchParams();
        data.append("confirmCode", document.getElementById("confirmCode").value.trim());
        data.append("objectPhone", document.getElementById("objectPhone").value.trim());
        data.append("resultValue", resultValue);
        data.append("objectRemark", document.getElementById("objectRemark").value.trim());

        var button = document.getElementById("btn_confirm");
        button.disabled = true;
        document.getElementById("confirmResult").innerHTML = "";

        fetch("/portal/site/service-confirm", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8"},
            body: data
        }).then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            if (result.code === 100) {
                showConfirmResult(result.msg, resultValue === "1");
            } else {
                showConfirmError(result.msg);
            }

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 门户志愿秀广场脚本：列表与详情全部取自 /portal/site/shows、/portal/site/show 公开接口，
     * 分页参数 page/size 与关键字 keyword 一一对应后端分页契约，接口不可用时降级为“暂无数据”。
     */
    var showPage = 1;
    var showSize = 6;
    var showKeyword = "";

    // HTML 转义，避免分享内容中的特殊字符破坏页面结构
    function portalEscapeHtml(value) {
        if (value === null || value === undefined) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    // 文本摘要：超过指定长度时截断并追加省略号
    function portalSummary(value, length) {
        var text = value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value);
        return text.length > length ? text.substring(0, length) + "…" : text;
    }

    // 统一时间显示格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
    function portalFormatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    // 从统一响应体中取出当前页列表，缺字段时按空列表处理
    function portalListOf(result) {
        return result && result.extend && result.extend.list ? result.extend.list : [];
    }

    // 分页信息与翻页按钮状态
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 594 页
    function portalRenderPager(total, page, size) {
        var totalPage = total > 0 ? Math.ceil(total / size) : 0;
        document.getElementById("showPageInfo").textContent =
            "第 " + (totalPage > 0 ? page : 0) + " / " + totalPage + " 页，共 " + total + " 条";
        document.getElementById("showPrevPage").disabled = page <= 1;
        document.getElementById("showNextPage").disabled = totalPage === 0 || page >= totalPage;
    }

    // 列表为空时渲染“暂无数据”行
    function portalEmptyList() {
        document.getElementById("showList").innerHTML =
            '<div class="col-12"><p class="text-muted">暂无数据</p></div>';
    }

    // 志愿秀列表：分页 + 关键字检索
    function portalLoadShows() {
        var container = document.getElementById("showList");
        var url = "/portal/site/shows?page=" + showPage + "&size=" + showSize
            + "&keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(showKeyword);
        fetch(url).then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            var list = portalListOf(result);
            var extend = result.extend ? result.extend : {};
            portalRenderPager(Number(extend.total || 0), Number(extend.page || showPage),
                Number(extend.size || showSize));
            if (!list.length) {
                portalEmptyList();
                return;
            }
            var html = "";
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                var show = list[i];
                html += '<div class="col-md-6 col-lg-4">'
                    + '<div class="card portal-show-card" data-num="'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(show.showNum) + '">';
                if (show.pictureRoute) {
                    html += '<img class="card-img-top" src="' + portalEscapeHtml(show.pictureRoute)
                        + '" alt="' + portalEscapeHtml(show.activityName || "志愿秀图片")
                        + '" style="height:200px;object-fit:cover;"/>';
                }
                html += '<div class="card-body">'
                    + '<h4 class="card-title">' + portalEscapeHtml(show.volunteerName || "匿名志愿者") + '</h4>'
                    + '<p class="text-muted">关联活动：'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(show.activityName || "未关联活动") + '</p>'
                    + '<p class="text-muted">分享时间：'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(portalFormatTime(show.showSharetime)) + '</p>'
                    + '<p class="card-text">' + portalEscapeHtml(portalSummary(show.showDetail, 60)) + '</p>'
                    + '<p class="text-muted">浏览 ' + Number(show.showBrowse || 0)
                    + ' 次 · 点赞 ' + Number(show.showLike || 0) + ' 次</p>'
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 595 页
                    + '<button class="btn btn-secondary portal-show-detail" type="button" data-num="'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(show.showNum) + '">查看详情</button>'
                    + '</div></div></div>';
            }
            container.innerHTML = html;
            var buttons = container.querySelectorAll(".portal-show-detail");
            for (var j = 0; j < buttons.length; j++) {
                buttons[j].addEventListener("click", function () {
                    portalShowDetail(this.getAttribute("data-num"));
                });
            }
        }).catch(function () {
            portalRenderPager(0, 1, showSize);
            portalEmptyList();
        });
    }

    // 志愿秀详情：展示完整内容与全部图片
    function portalShowDetail(showNum) {
        fetch("/portal/site/show?showNum=" + encodeURIComponent(showNum)).then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            var show = result.extend ? result.extend.show : null;
            if (result.code !== 100 || !show) {
                alert(result.msg || "该志愿秀不存在或已被删除");
                return;
            }
            var pictures = show.pictureRoutes ? show.pictureRoutes : [];
            var pictureHtml = "";
            if (pictures.length) {
                for (var i = 0; i < pictures.length; i++) {
                    pictureHtml += '<p><img src="' + portalEscapeHtml(pictures[i])
                        + '" alt="志愿秀图片" style="max-width:100%;"/></p>';
                }
            } else {
                pictureHtml = '<p class="text-muted">该志愿秀没有上传图片</p>';
            }
            portalOpenModal(show.volunteerName || "志愿秀详情",
                '<p class="text-muted">关联活动：' + portalEscapeHtml(show.activityName || "未关联活动")
                + ' · 分享时间：' + portalEscapeHtml(portalFormatTime(show.showSharetime))
                + ' · 浏览 ' + Number(show.showBrowse || 0) + ' 次 · 点赞 '
                + Number(show.showLike || 0) + ' 次</p>'
                + '<p>' + portalEscapeHtml(show.showDetail).replace(/\n/g, "<br>") + '</p>'
                + '<h4>志愿秀图片</h4>' + pictureHtml);
            // 详情接口会累加浏览次数，重新加载列表以保持展示的浏览数与后端一致
            portalLoadShows();
        }).catch(function () {
            alert("志愿秀详情加载失败，请稍后重试");
        });
    }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 596 页

    // 弹窗打开与关闭
    function portalOpenModal(title, bodyHtml) {
        document.getElementById("portalModalTitle").textContent = title || "";
        document.getElementById("portalModalBody").innerHTML = bodyHtml;
        document.getElementById("portalModal").style.display = "block";
    }

    function portalCloseModal() {
        document.getElementById("portalModal").style.display = "none";
    }

    document.getElementById("portalModalClose").addEventListener("click", portalCloseModal);
    document.getElementById("portalModal").addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (event.target === this) {
            portalCloseModal();
        }
    });

    // 关键字检索：重置到第一页后查询
    document.getElementById("showSearchForm").addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        showKeyword = document.getElementById("showKeyword").value.trim();
        showPage = 1;
        portalLoadShows();
    });

    // 翻页
    document.getElementById("showPrevPage").addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (showPage > 1) {
            showPage = showPage - 1;
            portalLoadShows();
        }
    });

    document.getElementById("showNextPage").addEventListener("click", function () {
        showPage = showPage + 1;
        portalLoadShows();
    });

    portalLoadShows();
</script>

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 拼接活动的服务时间区间
     */
    function formatActivityTime(activity) {
        var begin = formatTime(activity.activityBegintime);
        var end = formatTime(activity.activityEndtime);
        if (begin === "—" && end === "—") {
            return "—";
        }
        return begin + " ~ " + end;
    }

    /**
     * 将匹配度转换为 0-100 的整数
     */
    function formatScore(value) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 606 页
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num) || num < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        return Math.round(num);
    }

    /**
     * 格式化匹配度（进度条 + 分数）
     */
    function renderScore(value) {
        var score = formatScore(value);
        return '<div class="progress" style="height: 6px; width: 70px; display: inline-block;'
            + ' vertical-align: middle;">'
            + '<div class="progress-bar" role="progressbar" style="width: ' + score + '%;" aria-valuenow="'
            + score + '" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100"></div>'
            + '</div> <span class="small">' + score + ' 分</span>';
    }

    /**
     * 格式化活动与志愿者常住定位之间的距离
     */
    function formatDistance(distanceMeters) {
        if (distanceMeters === null || distanceMeters === undefined) {
            return "未设置定位";
        }
        var meters = Number(distanceMeters);
        if (isNaN(meters) || meters < 0) {
            return "未设置定位";
        }
        if (meters < 1000) {
            return Math.round(meters) + " 米";
        }
        return (meters / 1000).toFixed(1) + " 公里";
    }

    /**
     * 格式化活动的技能要求
     */
    function formatSkillNames(skillNames) {
        if (!skillNames) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(skillNames).replace(/,/g, "、");
    }

    /**
     * 格式化匹配理由
     */
    function formatReasons(reasons) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 607 页
        if (!reasons || reasons.length === 0) {
            return "—";
        }
        return reasons.join("；");
    }

    /**
     * 查询当前登录志愿者资料，并刷新侧边栏身份信息

    var volunteerProfile = null;
    var profileRequest = null;

    function loadProfile(onLoaded) {
        profileRequest = $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/profile",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.profile) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                volunteerProfile = result.extend.profile;
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(volunteerProfile.volunteerName || "志愿者");
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (volunteerProfile.volunteerId || "—"));
                if (onLoaded) {
                    onLoaded(volunteerProfile);
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
        return profileRequest;
    }

    /**
     * 确保已获取志愿者档案（报名前校验技能标签与常住定位）
     */
    function ensureProfile(callback) {
        if (volunteerProfile) {
            callback(volunteerProfile);
            return;
        }
        if (!profileRequest) {
            loadProfile(callback);
            return;
        }
        profileRequest.always(function () {

    }

    /**
     * 渲染智能匹配活动列表
     */
    function renderPlaza(activities) {
        var html = "";
        if (!activities || activities.length === 0) {
            html = '<tr><td colspan="9" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>';
        } else {
            $.each(activities, function (index, activity) {
                html += "<tr>"
                    + "<td>" + activity.activityName + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatActivityTime(activity) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (activity.activityLocation || "—") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + ((activity.activityNeedpeople === null || activity.activityNeedpeople === undefined)
                        ? "—" : activity.activityNeedpeople + " 人") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatDistance(activity.distanceMeters) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatSkillNames(activity.activitySkillNames) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + renderScore(activity.matchScore) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatReasons(activity.reasons) + "</td>"
                    + '<td><button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button" onclick="applyActivity('
                    + activity.activityNum + ')">报名</button></td>'
                    + "</tr>";
            });
        }
        $("#plaza_table").html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 活动广场分页与检索条件
     */
    var plazaPage = 1;
    var plazaSize = 10;
    var plazaKeyword = "";
    var plazaTotal = 0;

    /**
     * 渲染分页控件：条数、页码信息与上一页/下一页可用状态
     */
    function renderPager(total, current, pageSize) {
        plazaTotal = Number(total);
        if (isNaN(plazaTotal) || plazaTotal < 0) {
            plazaTotal = 0;
        }
        var currentPage = Number(current);
        if (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) {
            currentPage = 1;
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 609 页
        }
        var currentSize = Number(pageSize);
        if (isNaN(currentSize) || currentSize < 1) {
            currentSize = plazaSize;
        }
        var totalPages = plazaTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(plazaTotal / currentSize) : 1;
        $("#plaza_total").text("共 " + plazaTotal + " 条");
        $("#plaza_page_info").text("第 " + currentPage + " / " + totalPages + " 页");
        $("#plaza_prev").toggleClass("disabled", currentPage <= 1);
        $("#plaza_next").toggleClass("disabled",
            plazaTotal === 0 || currentPage >= totalPages);
    }

    /**
     * 加载智能匹配活动广场数据
     */
    function loadPlaza() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/plaza",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: plazaPage, size: plazaSize, keyword: plazaKeyword},
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                renderPlaza(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 按关键字检索活动广场，重新从第一页开始
     */
    function searchPlaza() {
        plazaKeyword = $.trim($("#plaza_keyword").val());
        plazaPage = 1;
        loadPlaza();
    }

    /**
     * 翻页：step 为 1 下一页、-1 上一页
     */
    function changePlazaPage(step) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 610 页
        var nextPage = plazaPage + step;
        var totalPages = plazaTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(plazaTotal / plazaSize) : 1;
        if (nextPage < 1 || nextPage > totalPages) {
            return;
        }
        plazaPage = nextPage;
        loadPlaza();
    }

    /**
     * 报名活动：报名前必须完善技能标签与常住定位
     */
    function applyActivity(activityNum) {
        ensureProfile(function (profile) {
            var skills = (profile && profile.skills) ? profile.skills : [];
            var hasLocation = !!(profile && profile.latitude !== null && profile.latitude !== undefined
                && profile.longitude !== null && profile.longitude !== undefined);
            if (!profile || skills.length === 0 || !hasLocation) {
                if (confirm("请先在“我的档案”中完善技能标签与常住定位，是否现在前往完善？")) {
                    window.location.href = "profile.html";
                }
                return;
            }
            $.ajax({
                url: "/volunteer/apply",
                type: "POST",
                data: {activityNum: activityNum},
                success: function (result) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                    if (result && result.code === 100) {
                        loadPlaza();
                    }
                },
                error: function (result) {
                    console.log(result);
                    alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
                }
            });
        });
    }

        $("#plaza_keyword").on("keydown", function (event) {
            if (event.keyCode === 13) {
                searchPlaza();
                return false;
            }

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将数值格式化为一位小数，非法数值按 0.0 处理
     */
    function formatHours(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num)) {
            num = 0;
        }
        return num.toFixed(1);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染服务明细列表
     */
    function renderRecords(records) {
        var html = "";
        if (!records || records.length === 0) {
            html = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>';
        } else {
            $.each(records, function (index, record) {
                html += "<tr>"
                    + "<td>" + (record.activityName || "—") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (record.activityId || "—") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatTime(record.serviceDate).substring(0, 10) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + ((record.duration === null || record.duration === undefined)
                        ? "—" : formatHours(record.duration) + " 小时") + "</td>"
                    + "</tr>";
            });
        }
        $("#certificate_table").html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染星级进度说明
     */
    function renderNextLevel(certificate) {
        var nextLevelName = certificate.nextLevelName;
        var hoursToNextLevel = Number(certificate.hoursToNextLevel);
        if (!nextLevelName) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 617 页
            $("#cert_next_level").text("已达成最高星级，感谢您的持续付出");
            return;
        }
        if (isNaN(hoursToNextLevel) || hoursToNextLevel < 0) {
            hoursToNextLevel = 0;
        }
        $("#cert_next_level").text("当前星级：" + (certificate.starLevel || "—")
            + "；距离「" + nextLevelName + "」还需 " + hoursToNextLevel.toFixed(1) + " 小时");
    }

    /**
     * 渲染志愿服务证明
     */
    function renderCertificate(certificate) {
        $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(certificate.volunteerName || "志愿者");
        $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (certificate.volunteerId || "—"));

        $("#cert_volunteer_name").text(certificate.volunteerName || "—");
        $("#cert_volunteer_id").text(certificate.volunteerId || "—");
        $("#cert_total_duration").text(formatHours(certificate.totalDuration));
        $("#cert_activity_count").text((certificate.activityCount === null
            || certificate.activityCount === undefined) ? "—" : certificate.activityCount);
        $("#cert_star_level").text(certificate.starLevel || "—");
        $("#cert_issue_date").text(certificate.issueDate || "—");
        $("#cert_verify_code").text(certificate.verifyCode || "—");

        renderNextLevel(certificate);
        renderRecords(certificate.records);
    }

    /**
     * 查询当前登录志愿者的志愿服务证明
     */
    function loadCertificate() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/certificate",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.certificate) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                renderCertificate(result.extend.certificate);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 618 页
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadCertificate();

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将数值格式化为一位小数，非法数值按 0.0 处理
     */
    function formatHours(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num)) {
            num = 0;
        }
        return num.toFixed(1);
    }

    /**
     * 拼接活动的服务时间区间
     */
    function formatActivityTime(activity) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 624 页
        var begin = formatTime(activity.activityBegintime);
        var end = formatTime(activity.activityEndtime);
        if (begin === "—" && end === "—") {
            return "—";
        }
        return begin + " ~ " + end;
    }

    /**
     * 查询当前登录志愿者资料，并刷新侧边栏身份信息
     */
    var volunteerProfile = null;

    function loadProfile(onLoaded) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/profile",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.profile) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                volunteerProfile = result.extend.profile;
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(volunteerProfile.volunteerName || "志愿者");
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (volunteerProfile.volunteerId || "—"));
                if (onLoaded) {
                    onLoaded(volunteerProfile);
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 渲染统计卡与成长进度
     */
    function renderProfile(profile) {
        $("#stat_duration").text(formatHours(profile.volunteerTotalDuration));
        $("#stat_credit").text((profile.volunteerCredit === null || profile.volunteerCredit === undefined)
            ? "—" : profile.volunteerCredit);
        $("#stat_star").text(profile.starLevel || "—");

        var nextLevelName = profile.nextLevelName;
        var nextLevelHours = Number(profile.nextLevelHours);
        var hoursToNextLevel = Number(profile.hoursToNextLevel);
        if (!nextLevelName || isNaN(nextLevelHours) || nextLevelHours <= 0) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 625 页
            $("#growth_text").text("已达成最高星级，感谢您的持续付出");
            $("#growth_progress").css("width", "100%").attr("aria-valuenow", 100);
            return;
        }
        if (isNaN(hoursToNextLevel) || hoursToNextLevel < 0) {
            hoursToNextLevel = 0;
        }
        var achieved = nextLevelHours - hoursToNextLevel;
        if (achieved < 0) {
            achieved = 0;
        }
        var percent = Math.round(achieved / nextLevelHours * 100);
        if (percent > 100) {
            percent = 100;
        }
        $("#growth_text").text("距离「" + nextLevelName + "」还需 " + hoursToNextLevel.toFixed(1) + " 小时");
        $("#growth_progress").css("width", percent + "%").attr("aria-valuenow", percent);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染“为你推荐”（取匹配度最高的前 3 条活动）
     */
    function renderRecommend(activities) {
        var $holder = $("#recommend_list").empty();
        if (!activities || activities.length === 0) {
            $holder.append('<div class="col-12 text-center text-muted">暂无数据</div>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(activities.slice(0, 3), function (index, activity) {
            html += '<div class="col-md-4">'
                + '<div class="card o-hidden">'
                + '<div class="card-body">'
                + '<h6 class="mb-1">' + activity.activityName + '</h6>'
                + '<p class="mb-1 text-muted small">服务时间：' + formatActivityTime(activity) + '</p>'
                + '<p class="mb-1 text-muted small">活动地点：' + (activity.activityLocation || "—") + '</p>'
                + '<p class="mb-2">匹配度：<span class="badge badge-primary">' + formatScore(activity.matchScore) + ' 分</span></p>'
                + renderReasons(activity.reasons)
                + '<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button" onclick="applyActivity('
                + activity.activityNum + ')">报名</button>'
                + '</div>'
                + '</div>'
                + '</div>';
        });
        $holder.html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 将匹配度转换为 0-100 的整数
     */
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 626 页
    function formatScore(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num) || num < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        return Math.round(num);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染匹配理由列表
     */
    function renderReasons(reasons) {
        if (!reasons || reasons.length === 0) {
            return '<p class="mb-2 text-muted small">暂无匹配理由</p>';
        }
        var html = '<ul class="list-unstyled mb-2 small">';
        $.each(reasons, function (index, reason) {
            html += '<li>• ' + reason + '</li>';
        });
        html += '</ul>';
        return html;
    }

    /**
     * 渲染工作台最近 5 条本人报名记录
     */
    function renderParticipations(participations) {
        var html = "";
        if (!participations || participations.length === 0) {
            html = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>';
        } else {
            $.each(participations, function (index, item) {
                html += "<tr>"
                    + "<td>" + item.activityName + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatTime(item.participateApplytime) + "</td>"
                    + '<td><span class="' + applyStateClass(item.participateApplystate) + '">'
                    + (item.participateApplystateText || "—") + '</span></td>'
                    + "<td>" + ((item.participateDuration === null || item.participateDuration === undefined)
                        ? "—" : formatHours(item.participateDuration) + " 小时") + "</td>"
                    + "</tr>";
            });
        }
        $("#participation_table").html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 报名状态对应的文字颜色
     */
    function applyStateClass(state) {
        if (state === "1") {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 627 页
            return "text-success";
        }
        if (state === "2") {
            return "text-danger";
        }
        if (state === "3") {
            return "text-warning";
        }
        return "text-muted";
    }

    /**
     * 加载智能匹配活动广场数据
     */
    function loadPlaza() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/plaza",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: 1, size: 3},
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                renderRecommend(result.extend.list);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 加载我的报名列表
     */
    function loadParticipations() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/myParticipations",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: 1, size: 5},
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                var participations = result.extend.list || [];
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 628 页
                $("#stat_activity").text(result.extend.total || participations.length);
                renderParticipations(participations);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 加载顶部未读消息数
     */
    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (result && result.code === 100 && result.extend) {
                    $("#header_unread_count").text(result.extend.count || 0);
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }


    /**
     * 报名推荐活动，返回提示直接展示给志愿者
     */
    function applyActivity(activityNum) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/apply",
            type: "POST",
            data: {activityNum: activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    loadPlaza();
                    loadParticipations();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将数值格式化为一位小数，非法数值按 0.0 处理
     */
    function formatHours(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num)) {
            num = 0;
        }
        return num.toFixed(1);
    }

    /**
     * 拼接活动的服务时间区间
     */
    function formatActivityTime(item) {
        var begin = formatTime(item.activityBegintime);
        var end = formatTime(item.activityEndtime);
        if (begin === "—" && end === "—") {
            return "—";
        }
        return begin + " ~ " + end;
    }

    /**
     * 查询当前登录志愿者资料，并刷新侧边栏身份信息
     */
    function loadProfile() {

            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.profile) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;

                $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(profile.volunteerName || "志愿者");
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (profile.volunteerId || "—"));
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 报名状态对应的文字颜色
     */
    function applyStateHtml(item) {
        var stateClass = "text-muted";
        if (item.participateApplystate === "1") {
            stateClass = "text-success";
        } else if (item.participateApplystate === "2") {
            stateClass = "text-danger";
        } else if (item.participateApplystate === "3") {
            stateClass = "text-warning";
        }
        return '<span class="' + stateClass + '">' + (item.participateApplystateText || "—") + '</span>';
    }

    /**
     * 服务时长复核状态（null 待复核、1 已确认、2 已驳回）
     */
    function timecheckHtml(value) {
        if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== "" && String(value) === "1") {
            return '<span class="badge badge-success">已确认</span>';
        }
        if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== "" && String(value) === "2") {
            return '<span class="badge badge-danger">已驳回</span>';
        }
        return '<span class="badge badge-secondary">待复核</span>';
    }

    /**
     * 服务记录来源文案：1 平台签到、2 组织补录

    function sourceHtml(item) {
        if (item.checkinSource === null || item.checkinSource === undefined || item.checkinSource === "") {
            return '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';
        }
        var source = String(item.checkinSource);
        if (source === "1") {
            return '<span class="badge badge-primary">平台签到</span>';
        }
        if (source === "2") {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 636 页
            return '<span class="badge badge-warning">组织补录</span>';

    /**
     * 参加确认状态：空 待确认、1 已确认、2 已放弃

    function confirmStateHtml(item) {

    /**

    var partPage = 1;
    var partSize = 10;
    var partTotal = 0;

    /**
     * 渲染分页控件：条数、页码信息与上一页/下一页可用状态
     */
    function renderPager(total, current, pageSize) {
        partTotal = Number(total);
        if (isNaN(partTotal) || partTotal < 0) {
            partTotal = 0;
        }
        var currentPage = Number(current);
        if (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) {
            currentPage = 1;
        }
        var currentSize = Number(pageSize);
        if (isNaN(currentSize) || currentSize < 1) {
            currentSize = partSize;
        }
        var totalPages = partTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(partTotal / currentSize) : 1;
        $("#part_total").text("共 " + partTotal + " 条");
        $("#part_page_info").text("第 " + currentPage + " / " + totalPages + " 页");
        $("#part_prev").toggleClass("disabled", currentPage <= 1);
        $("#part_next").toggleClass("disabled", partTotal === 0 || currentPage >= totalPages);
    }

    /**
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 637 页
     * 翻页：step 为 1 下一页、-1 上一页
     */
    function changePartPage(step) {
        var nextPage = partPage + step;
        var totalPages = partTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(partTotal / partSize) : 1;
        if (nextPage < 1 || nextPage > totalPages) {
            return;
        }
        partPage = nextPage;
        loadParticipations();
    }

    /**
     * 操作列按钮：确认参加、放弃参加（待确认时）、签到、签退、撤回报名与公告入口
     */
    function actionHtml(item) {
        var buttons = "";
        if (item.canConfirm) {
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-success btn-xs" type="button" onclick="confirmParticipation('
                + item.participateNum + ', 1)">确认参加</button> ';
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-outline-warning btn-xs" type="button" onclick="confirmParticipation('
                + item.participateNum + ', 2)">放弃参加</button> ';
        }
        if (item.canCheckin) {
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button" onclick="prepareCheckin('
                + item.activityNum + ')" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#checkinModal">签到</button> ';
        }
        if (item.canCheckout) {
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-info btn-xs" type="button" onclick="checkoutActivity('
                + item.activityNum + ')">签退</button> ';
        }
        if (item.canCancel) {
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-xs" type="button" onclick="cancelParticipation('
                + item.participateNum + ')">撤回报名</button> ';
        }
        buttons += '<a class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-xs" href="training.html">查看公告</a>';
        return buttons;
    }

    /**

    function renderParticipations(participations) {

    function loadParticipations() {

    }

    /**
     * 获取浏览器当前定位，取不到时返回空经纬度
     */
    function getPosition(callback) {
        if (!navigator.geolocation) {
            callback("", "");
            return;
        }
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function (position) {
            callback(position.coords.latitude, position.coords.longitude);
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 639 页
        }, function () {
            callback("", "");
        }, {enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000, maximumAge: 0});
    }

    /**
     * 打开签到弹窗前的准备：记录活动编号并清空上次填写内容
     */
    function prepareCheckin(activityNum) {
        $("#checkin_activity_num").val(activityNum);
        $("#checkin_code").val("");
        $("#checkin_latitude").val("");
        $("#checkin_longitude").val("");
    }

    /**
     * 将浏览器定位结果填充到签到弹窗的经纬度输入框
     */
    function fillCheckinLocation() {
        getPosition(function (latitude, longitude) {
            if (latitude === "" || longitude === "") {
                alert("未能获取当前位置，可直接提交签到，系统将标记为异常并交志愿者组织复核");
                return;
            }
            $("#checkin_latitude").val(latitude);
            $("#checkin_longitude").val(longitude);
        });
    }

    /**
     * 关闭签到弹窗
     */
    function hideCheckinModal() {
        var modalElement = document.getElementById("checkinModal");
        if (window.bootstrap && bootstrap.Modal && modalElement) {
            var modalInstance = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(modalElement);
            if (modalInstance) {
                modalInstance.hide();
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * 提交签到（活动编号 + 现场签到码 + 定位）
     */
    function submitCheckin() {
        var code = $.trim($("#checkin_code").val());
        if (!code) {
            alert("请输入现场公布的签到码");
            return;
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 640 页
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/checkin/in",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                activityNum: $("#checkin_activity_num").val(),
                code: code,
                latitude: $("#checkin_latitude").val(),
                longitude: $("#checkin_longitude").val()
            },
            success: function (result) {
                hideCheckinModal();
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                loadParticipations();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                hideCheckinModal();
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
                loadParticipations();
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 签退：先获取定位，再提交签退
     */
    function checkoutActivity(activityNum) {
        getPosition(function (latitude, longitude) {
            $.ajax({
                url: "/checkin/out",
                type: "POST",
                data: {activityNum: activityNum, latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude},
                success: function (result) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                    loadParticipations();
                },
                error: function (result) {
                    console.log(result);
                    alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
                    loadParticipations();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    /**

    function cancelParticipation(participateNum) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 641 页
        if (!confirm("确认撤回该志愿活动的报名？")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/cancel",
            type: "POST",
            data: {participateNum: participateNum},
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                loadParticipations();

    /**
     * 确认参加或放弃参加已通过审核的报名（confirmState：1 确认参加、2 放弃参加）
     */
    function confirmParticipation(participateNum, confirmState) {
        var tip = confirmState === 1
            ? "确认参加该志愿活动？"
            : "放弃参加后名额将释放给候补志愿者，确认放弃？";
        if (!confirm(tip)) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/confirm",
            type: "POST",
            data: {participateNum: participateNum, confirmState: confirmState},
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                loadParticipations();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
                loadParticipations();
            }
        });
    }

<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
     */
    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 通知分页条件
     */
    var notifPage = 1;
    var notifSize = 10;
    var notifTotal = 0;

    /**
     * 判断通知是否未读（notificationRead 为 1 表示已读）
     */
    function isUnread(item) {
        return String(item.notificationRead) !== "1";
    }

    /**
     * 查询当前登录志愿者资料，并刷新侧边栏身份信息
     */
    function loadProfile() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/profile",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.profile) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                var profile = result.extend.profile;
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(profile.volunteerName || "志愿者");
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (profile.volunteerId || "—"));
            },
            error: function (result) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 647 页
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 渲染通知列表，未读通知使用高亮行
     */
    function renderNotifications(notifications) {
        var html = "";
        if (!notifications || notifications.length === 0) {
            html = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>';
        } else {
            $.each(notifications, function (index, item) {
                var unread = isUnread(item);
                html += "<tr" + (unread ? ' class="table-primary"' : "") + ">"
                    + "<td>" + (item.notificationTitle || "—") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (item.notificationDetail || "—") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatTime(item.notificationTime) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (unread
                        ? '<span class="badge badge-danger">未读</span>'
                        : '<span class="badge badge-secondary">已读</span>') + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (unread
                        ? '<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button" onclick="markRead('
                            + item.notificationNum + ')">标记已读</button>'
                        : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>') + "</td>"
                    + "</tr>";
            });
        }
        $("#notification_table").html(html);
    }

    /**
     * 渲染分页控件：条数、页码信息与上一页/下一页可用状态
     */
    function renderPager(total, current, pageSize) {
        notifTotal = Number(total);
        if (isNaN(notifTotal) || notifTotal < 0) {
            notifTotal = 0;
        }
        var currentPage = Number(current);
        if (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) {
            currentPage = 1;
        }
        var currentSize = Number(pageSize);
        if (isNaN(currentSize) || currentSize < 1) {
            currentSize = notifSize;
        }
        var totalPages = notifTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(notifTotal / currentSize) : 1;
        $("#notif_total").text("共 " + notifTotal + " 条");
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 648 页
        $("#notif_page_info").text("第 " + currentPage + " / " + totalPages + " 页");
        $("#notif_prev").toggleClass("disabled", currentPage <= 1);
        $("#notif_next").toggleClass("disabled", notifTotal === 0 || currentPage >= totalPages);
    }

    /**
     * 加载当前登录志愿者的站内通知
     */
    function loadNotifications() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/notifications",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: notifPage, size: notifSize},
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                renderNotifications(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 翻页：step 为 1 下一页、-1 上一页
     */
    function changeNotifPage(step) {
        var nextPage = notifPage + step;
        var totalPages = notifTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(notifTotal / notifSize) : 1;
        if (nextPage < 1 || nextPage > totalPages) {
            return;
        }
        notifPage = nextPage;
        loadNotifications();
    }

    /**
     * 将单条通知标记为已读
     */
    function markRead(notificationNum) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/notifications/read",
            type: "POST",
            data: {notificationNum: notificationNum},
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                      第 649 页
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    loadNotifications();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 将全部通知标记为已读
     */
    function markAllRead() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/notifications/readAll",
            type: "POST",
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    notifPage = 1;
                    loadNotifications();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadProfile();
        loadNotifications();
    });
</script>

    /**
     * 将后端返回的时间格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    /**
     * 将数值格式化为一位小数，非法数值按 0.0 处理
     */
    function formatHours(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num)) {
            num = 0;
        }
        return num.toFixed(1);
    }

    /**
     * 判断坐标是否已设置
